changes: Simplified the notch shortcut hints to Talk and Open, matching the Open Omi shortcut named in Settings
The notch Omi mark now reacts to live audio: the waveform follows your voice as you speak, and the ring pulses with the assistant's actual speech output
Fixed voice questions that need a smarter answer or a live web lookup — the assistant can escalate and search the web again instead of failing silently
Fixed push-to-talk getting stuck listening when you interrupt Omi mid-answer and immediately ask something else
